editorial:
Imagine two of the biggest movie stars in the world fighting over a single job. You get to see Robert De Niro and Leonardo DiCaprio stop being teammates and start acting like rivals. They are both trying to impress Martin Scorsese to land the lead role in his next big project. The whole vibe is light and funny, turning the usual serious drama these actors do into a giant competition. It feels like watching a high-stakes game of chicken where neither guy wants to back down, and the banter between them is gold.

What really makes this work is how the two leads play off each other. The pacing is quick, and the jokes land perfectly. While some parts feel a bit like an inside joke for movie buffs, anyone who likes a good comedy will enjoy the chaos. If you want the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the funny facial expressions. Or, if you love owning movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: At the very end, Scorsese reveals that he actually does not want either of them for the part. He tells them that their fighting proved they are too stubborn to work together. The big twist is that he casts a completely unknown actor instead. De Niro and DiCaprio end up shaking hands and laughing at themselves, realizing they took the whole thing way too seriously. They walk out of the room as friends again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves seeing big stars act silly and competitive.
